sources.observation: Official text specifically identifies the clock/cross tower as light brick-red, separately from round Chang Jung Hall. Image shows same two slab bodies with broad red-brown faces, narrow light/gray edges and gray tops; broad opposite faces not directly documented by this view.
sources.inference: Apply same light brick-red family only to the opposite broad face of each same continuous slab. This is explicit same-component surface-material continuity, not new backside photo evidence, not whole tower painting. Narrow edge stripes, top caps, aperture wall reveals and ties remain unconfirmed.
